description: Northern Ireland Bus Compliance Check is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Department of the Environment. This is a report providing information on the biennial Bus Compliance Check, which is carried out to determine the roadworthiness and traffic compliance of buses travelling on the roads in Northern Ireland. Source agency: Environment (Northern Ireland) Designation: Official Statistics not designated as National Statistics Language: English Alternative title: Northern Ireland Bus Compliance Check 2011. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Department of the Environment. The portal shows 2026-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is UK Open Government Licence (OGL). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
